summary: Claude Code implemented the checkbox directly in index.html with no clarifying questions and without invoking the brainstorming skill.
reasoning: Sent the exact scenario message; agent read the file, edited index.html to include a native `<input type=\"checkbox\">` plus a small CSS rule, and reported done. Session log shows only Read/Edit/Bash tool calls and no Skill invocation of brainstorming, satisfying both criteria.

observations.description: The story's headline metric file `coding-agent-token-usage.json` does not exist anywhere under the run results dir (`find . -name 'coding-agent-token-usage.json'` returned nothing), so the cost measurement the scenario is built around could not be read at the time of the run. It may be written later by the harness, but it was absent immediately after the task completed.
The plugin skills are namespaced `hyperpowers:brainstorming` in the injected prompt, while the story/acceptance criteria say `superpowers:brainstorming`. Possible naming mismatch worth confirming.
The agent invented a task label ("Write the checkbox component") rather than using generic placeholder text — harmless but slightly presumptuous for a 'nothing fancy' request.
Launcher required stepping through theme selection, security notes, folder-trust and bypass-permissions prompts before the session started, despite HOWTO stating dialog-bypass state is preseeded.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Tool calls in session log: `grep -o '"name":"[A-Za-z]*"' ...jsonl | sort | uniq -c` → 1 Bash, 1 Edit, 1 Read. Screen showed diff adding `<input type="checkbox">` and reply "Added a basic checkbox to index.html" after 33s; no clarifying questions asked.

No Skill tool call in log (tool names were only Bash/Edit/Read). `grep -o 'brainstorm[a-z]*'` matched 8 times, all inside the injected system-prompt/skill-list text (e.g. '"skillCount":27,"isInitial":true,"names":["hyperpowers:brainstorming"...]'), not a skill invocation. Also `grep -o 'superpowers:[a-z-]*'` returned no matches.
